summary: PASS. ClauseClock Stage 2 accuracy repair fully verified. Added two new deterministic test files covering the three delta pieces (typographic normalization, high-recall locate-union fallback, one-shot found:false retry) and re-ran ALL existing regressions. Totals: 89/89 tests pass across 6 files (Stage 1 gate 7, Fix A marker-tolerant 20, NEW Stage 2 typography 38, NEW Stage 2 locate/retry 5, Stage 2 defects 10, Stage 2 happy-path 9). Key verified properties: (1) analysis._norm is strictly 1:1 (character-length preserved for every mapped code point) — so offsets returned from find_quote_offset_marker_tolerant index the ORIGINAL raw_text; verified for all curly quotes (U+2018/2019/201A/201B/201C/201D/201E/201F), dashes (U+2010–U+2015, U+2212), and spaces (U+00A0/2007/2009/202F/2060/FEFF). (2) STRICT semantics preserved after normalization: wrong-word, paraphrase, reordered-tokens, extra-word, absent-word quotes ALL return None — normalization did NOT enable fuzzy matching. (3) Marker + typography combined: quotes that BOTH span '========== Page N ==========' AND use ASCII typography while raw has Unicode still resolve to the correct integer offset into original raw_text and validate_sources end-to-end returns location 'p.1' (starting page). (4) Zero-source invariant preserved: monkeypatched extract with non-verbatim quotes yields findings=[], warnings=['Candidate renewal language was detected, but no source quote could be validated.'], persisted findings=[], HTTP /findings=[]. (5) High-recall locate fallback: with AI locate returning [] and hint chunks present, extract IS still called with the hint chunks and a valid finding is produced. (6) found:false retry is EXACTLY-ONCE: 2 extract calls when hints exist and both return false (no infinite loop), 1 extract call when no hint chunks exist (non-renewing contract stays no-finding). (7) Deterministic deadline arithmetic: effective 2026-03-15 + 12 months - 60 days = 2027-01-14; leap-year 2027-03-31 + 12 months - 60 days = 2028-01-31 (verified crossing Feb 29); rolls forward past today using renewal_period until > today. (8) Multi-purpose sources: single clause supports both renewal_term and notice_period (validated via real LLM in TestMultiPurposeSources). (9) Provenance integrity: stored char_offset for every source == analysis.find_quote_offset_marker_tolerant(raw_text, stored_quote) — recomputed via HTTP and matched exactly. (10) Auth isolation: cross-user GET/POST returns 404 for all created contracts. (11) RENEWAL_HINT regex matches 8/8 common renewal wordings, does not match 4/4 unrelated wordings. NO code was modified.
critical_code_review_comments: analysis.py Stage 2 accuracy repair is clean and minimal. _TYPO_TABLE is exhaustive for the observed pdfplumber outputs and every entry is 1:1 so _norm preserves character offsets (verified with a per-codepoint length assertion). find_quote_offset_marker_tolerant applies _norm to BOTH sides before re.escape+\s+ join — words must still match exactly and in order (no fuzzy). _clean_with_map's offset_map correctly re-maps cleaned matches back to the ORIGINAL raw string. RENEWAL_HINT is conservative enough to avoid false hint-unions on unrelated clauses. run_renewal_analysis's retry is guarded by 'hint_ids' AND 'found is False' AND 'focus not empty' — no risk of infinite loops. Zero-source invariant enforced BEFORE any persistence. No code changes recommended.
